articles.title: LE SSERAFIM Owns the Dark: Inside Made My Night’s Total Takeover
articles.description: The 2nd Single Album drops Source Music’s sharpest weapon yet — five girls, one frequency, and a version of K-pop that refuses to ask permission. It starts with static. Not the metaphor — the literal kind, particles suspended mid-air like the frame itself is glitching under the weight of what’s standing in it. Three girls, backlit, dressed like the aftermath of a blackout at a rave inside a server room. Nobody’s smiling. Nobody needs to. This is the first image the world sees from Made My Night,
articles.summary: LE SSERAFIM released their second single album "Made My Night," which showcases a darker, more distinctive K-pop sound from Source Music. The project features five members in a conceptually bold visual and sonic direction that stands out in the industry.
articles.author: Kpoppie Editorial Team
